integrity: The all-parameter conclusion is analytic. Finite numerical checks only corroborate the closed formula and are not used as exhaustive evidence.
scientific_limitations: The result proves strict local improvability of the displayed canonical rank-one encoder with the paper's partial-trace decoder for every \(d\ge2\) and \(0<p<1\). It does not determine the globally optimal rank-one encoder or decoder, the exact value of \(F_1^{\mathrm{opt}}\), or higher-order optimized gap coefficients.
title: The canonical rank-one AQEC comparator is never fixed-noise stationary
